title: What to do as a family in January | Family Season
description: Three ready plans for January for the whole family: a year capsule with letters to open on 31 December, a book month with a swap shelf for the neighbours, and a month of guests. Open one, change it, print it on A4.
label: January
heading: What to do as a family in January
lead: January is unfair: the first week is all holiday, and then comes the longest dark stretch of the year, with the tree already out on the pavement and spring still a long way off.
The promises made on the first are usually over by the tenth. So January is better written down than promised — the three plans below are three ways to spend it.
seasonsText: Each one opens in full: the weeks, a project for everybody in the family, the goal of the month. Any of them can be rewritten for you and printed on two A4 sheets.
actionText: If none of them fits, build your own: the theme of the month, four weeks and a project each. It prints the same way — two pages, and onto the fridge.
moreText: Other families put their seasons up too — there are more on the showcase.
